section: Understanding the Tekton Results retention policy (Abstract)
job_statement: When I need to manage how long pipeline results are kept, I want to understand the retention policy system, so I can configure data retention according to my organization's needs.
desired_outcomes: Minimize time to configure appropriate retention
Ensure compliance with data retention requirements
notes: Main job covering understanding of the retention policy system. The abstract provides clear context about the Retention Policy Agent managing database retention.

section: Understanding the Tekton Results retention policy (Abstract)
job_statement: When I need to set default retention periods for all results, I want to configure global retention settings, so I can establish baseline data retention without defining policies for every namespace.
desired_outcomes: Minimize time to set organization-wide retention
Ensure consistent default retention across all namespaces
notes: Main job covering global default retention configuration via defaultRetention, runAt schedule, and maxRetention fields.

section: Understanding the Tekton Results retention policy (Abstract)
job_statement: When I need different retention periods for specific results, I want to define fine-grained retention policies based on namespaces, labels, annotations, or statuses, so I can optimize storage costs while retaining critical results longer.
desired_outcomes: Minimize storage costs by pruning non-critical results sooner
Ensure critical results (failures, production) are retained longer
Reduce time to find and configure appropriate retention criteria
evidence: understanding-tekton-results-retention-policy-self-managed-reduced.adoc -> Abstract and TektonConfig YAML example, lines 63-136
notes: Main job covering fine-grained policies that override defaultRetention. The YAML example shows policies array with name, selector, and retention fields.

section: Understanding the Tekton Results retention policy (Config Map Fields)
job_statement: When I need to understand available retention configuration options, I want to reference field definitions and defaults, so I can configure retention settings correctly.
desired_outcomes: Minimize time to understand configuration options
Ensure correct use of deprecated fields
notes: Reference material covering runAt, defaultRetention, maxRetention, and policies fields with descriptions and defaults.

job_statement: When I need to target specific results for different retention periods, I want to use policy selectors with matchNamespaces, matchLabels, matchAnnotations, and matchStatuses, so I can apply retention rules based on multiple criteria.
parent_job: Define fine-grained retention policies based on namespaces, labels, annotations, or statuses
desired_outcomes: Minimize time to configure complex retention rules
Ensure all required criteria are matched (AND logic)
Reduce likelihood of incorrect policy matching
notes: User story showing how to implement fine-grained policies using the selector fields. The concept explains AND logic and field purposes.

job_statement: When I need to configure multiple retention policies with different priorities, I want to order policies by precedence and see working examples, so I can implement retention strategies that match my organization's needs.
parent_job: Define fine-grained retention policies based on namespaces, labels, annotations, or statuses
desired_outcomes: Minimize time to implement multi-policy retention strategies
evidence: understanding-tekton-results-retention-policy-self-managed-reduced.adoc -> Example config map and policy application examples, lines 178-226
notes: User story showing complete config map with multiple policies and examples of how Tekton Results applies them. Demonstrates policy precedence and real-world scenarios.
